title: A tracking change is refused once the user can no longer delete parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role D, with Part Library & Inventory — View, Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit, Part Library & Inventory — Delete and See Financial Data, so user D starts with the right to delete parts.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user D, at the test location with role D.
  • Use two browser windows: window 1 signed in as the Admin, window 2 (a private window) signed in as user D.
  • Create an active, tracked part, part A, for this test, with 2 on hand.
  • Start window 1 on role D's Edit Role page (Roles & Permissions), with nothing changed yet.
  • Start window 2 on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. In window 2, click the part A row.
  2. In window 2, click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. In window 1, untick Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit.
  4. In window 1, untick Part Library & Inventory — Delete.
  5. In window 1, untick See Financial Data.
  6. In window 1, untick every permission in the Settings group.
  7. In window 1, click Save.
  8. In window 2, click Save.
  9. In window 1, click Parts in the top bar.
  10. In window 1, click Inventory in the left menu.
  11. In window 1, type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A, with the switch on.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off. Do not save yet.

Step 3:

  • The Create & Edit box is unticked.

Step 4:

  • The Delete box is unticked.

Step 5:

  • The See Financial Data box is unticked.

Step 6:

  • Every Settings permission is unticked.

Step 7:

  • Role D is saved with only Part Library & Inventory — View left in the Part Library and Inventory group: user D now cannot delete inventory parts.

Step 8:

  • An access error appears saying user D is not allowed to do this (access denied), and the change is not saved.

Step 9:

  • Window 1 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 10:

  • Window 1 shows the Inventory page on the Active tab.

Step 11:

  • Part A still shows 2 Available in Total Qty, not "Not Tracked": its tracking did not change.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S8-N2: “If that user tries to change a part's tracking by any route, the request is refused with an access denied error.”
  • S8-R15: “The system accepts a status change, a tracking change and an untracked part from exactly the users it accepts an inventory part delete from today.”
  • Story 8, context note: “Context note: S8-N1 to S8-N3 hold for a user who cannot delete inventory parts today. The system checks that access itself, so hiding the controls is not the only protection.”
